evidence.C1: Title screen shows needed keys; first job beam stands 40m ahead in the car's own lane; learner phase prevents stars until first job done; first job is 270m ending at Sol Wheel pier landmark; car cannot be wrecked during first job
evidence.C2: Four districts with distinct looks (Meridian towers, Sol Beach pastels, Rustport industry, suburbs); 86 painted walls; neon trim, lit windows, day/night cycle; screenshots show recognizable neon-lit city with Ferris wheel, sunset skies, varied building colors
evidence.C3: Six story jobs ($250-$3,500), six odd job kinds (Rush Order, Repo Run, Block Dash, Hot Parcel, Paper Round, Shadow Run), cab fares with streak bonuses, four properties with rent, 15 hidden packages, police 1-5 stars with helicopter, Tune-up shop, perks tying activities together
evidence.C4: HUD reduced to cash and health; stars only when wanted; weapon line only 5s; clock moved to map/pause; G8 passed no overlaps at 3 sizes; perk card shows progress; pause screen is three buttons plus settings and perks
evidence.C5: Own city and names (G9 passed); title screen states 'not affiliated with the publisher or the series it is often compared to'; fact sheet plainly states 'No real players have tried it yet', 'No real phone or tablet has run the game yet', and reports failed test runs (job 5: 0 of 3)

fixes: Fix police ramming behavior: 'at two stars a police car with a clear view drives straight at the player at top speed; one head-on hit takes most of the stolen car's health and also counts as a crime, so the stars climb' — this made Heat Wave finish 0 of 3 and Borrowed Time 1 of 2 in scripted runs

Get real human playtesting: 'No real players have tried it yet. The scores are from AI judges reading this sheet and the screenshots' — scripted runs cannot judge whether jobs are fun or whether the first minute actually guides a stranger

Test on real mobile hardware: 'No real phone or tablet has run the game yet, so thumb reach, heat and frame rate on a phone are not known' — touch controls are a major feature (release 1.5) but only emulated

evidence.C1: First view shows 'Get into the red car ahead [F]' with 'JOB 40 m' and the car in-lane; 'the script now finishes it in 29.7 to 47.9 s'; learner phase means the first minute 'cannot end in a burning car' or arrest. Falls short of 10 only because no stranger has actually played it and the chain needs three read prompt lines plus the title key list.
evidence.C2: Screenshots show a consistent readable style: 'Meridian towers are aqua, coral, cream and lilac', neon Sol Wheel at dusk, lit windows and light pools at night, distinct districts. Not a 10: the low-poly pastel-neon look is a familiar idiom and some night streets (screenshot 7) remain plain dark blocks.
evidence.C3: 'Perks (release 1.2) tie the side activities together'; the wheel ride 'marks the three nearest unfound packages'; six job kinds plus cab, property, packages, tune-up. Held back by the police pillar: Heat Wave 'finished 0 of 3 runs', head-on rams take most health and raise stars, 'Not fixed in this version'.
evidence.C4: G8 'no overlaps at 3 sizes'; in-car HUD is 'cash and health' plus prompt, minimap and speed - reads at a glance on desktop. Not a 10: the phone screen stacks map, speed, radio, car name, district, perk card, objective and hint over the view, and the perk card sits mid-screen while driving.
evidence.C5: 'Own city, names and art' with the not-affiliated line (G9 pass); limits stated plainly: 'No real players have tried it yet', 'nobody has listened to it', 'Not fixed in this version', failed run counts reported as-is.

fixes: Rework police chase balance: at 2+ stars patrols ram head-on at top speed, one hit takes most of the car's health and counts as a crime so stars climb; Heat Wave finished 0 of 3 even by script and it is listed as 'Not fixed in this version'.

Get real humans and real hardware on it: no player has tried it and 'no real phone or tablet has run the game yet', so the first-minute promise and thumb reach, heat and frame rate on phones are unverified.

Measure job difficulty and time limits with a person: jobs 3-5, the odd jobs, cab fares and courier shift are script-checked only, and several time out or end in arrest even for the script under load.
